DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込用紙のどの欄についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which field on the bank transfer form are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 学校から、学生番号を名前の前に入れるよう言われました。受取人の名前を変えるんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学生番号を入れる欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The school told me to put the student number before the name. Should I change the recipient's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which field should contain the student number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取人は学校の指定口座の名義です。指示は振込依頼人名についてではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The recipient is the account holder designated by the school. Could the instruction refer to the sender's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には「依頼人名」とあります。私の名前の前に番号を入れるということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼人名の指定だと読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The guide says “sender's name.” So I should put the number before my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reread and identify the sender-name instruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。学校側が支払った人を照合するための指定と思われます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. It appears to be a requirement so the school can match the payment to the person paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 息子の授業料を私が払います。番号の後は私の名前か息子の名前か、学校に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 親子どちらの名前か学校へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am paying my son's tuition. I will ask the school whether the name after the number should be mine or my son's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with the school whether to use the parent's or child's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認してから記入される方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be better to check before filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 学校へ聞けました。息子の学生番号と息子の名前を入れる指定でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 学校の回答を銀行へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I reached the school. Their instruction is to enter my son's student number and his name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the bank the school's answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その指定どおり依頼人名を入力できる方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will show you how to enter the sender's name as instructed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受取人は学校名のまま、依頼人名だけ指定に合わせます。実行前の画面で両方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取人を変えず依頼人欄を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the school as the recipient and adjust only the sender's name to the instruction. I will check both on the screen before executing the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the recipient unchanged and check the sender field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 金額も合わせてご確認ください。確認後にお手続きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please also check the amount. Proceed after confirming everything.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の途中ですね。どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are in the middle of checkout. What is the matter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 千円を入れましたが、残りの現金がありません。カードに変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 投入後の現金不足と切替希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I inserted 1,000 yen, but I have no more cash. I would like to switch to a card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lack cash after inserting some and want to switch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加で操作せずお待ちください。今入れた金額を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait without making any further operations. We will check the amount inserted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面に千円と出ています。カードをそのまま差してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 投入額を示しカード操作の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The screen shows 1,000 yen. Can I just insert my card now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the inserted amount and ask whether to use the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いったん現金の扱いを確認してから、支払方法を変更します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check what to do with the cash first, then change the payment method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。千円が戻るかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 投入分の返金を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I would also like to check whether the 1,000 yen will be returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the refund of the inserted cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取消操作で返金された現金を、ご自身でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check for yourself the cash refunded by the cancellation operation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 千円が戻りました。まだ購入代金を払った状態ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返金後は未払いだと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The 1,000 yen has come back. So the purchase is still unpaid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that it remains unpaid after the refund. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。次にカードで全額のお支払いをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. Next, please pay the full amount by card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではカードを使います。完了表示が出てからレシートを取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全額をカードで払い完了を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will use my card. I will take the receipt after the completion message appears.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay the full amount by card and wait for completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 決済が完了しました。レシートと現金のお忘れ物にお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Payment is complete. Please be careful not to leave your receipt or cash behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出口への道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the way to the exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。池の後に左へ曲がるつもりでしたが、標識を見ないままここまで来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 曲がる所を見失った経過を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I intended to turn left after the pond, but I came this far without seeing the sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain how you lost the turning point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に見た標識の文字は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember the words on the last sign you saw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「管理棟」とありました。池は今、私の後ろにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の標識と池の位置を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It said “Administration Building.” The pond is behind me now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the last sign and the pond's position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理棟の分かれ道を通り過ぎたようです。まずこの舗装路を戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You seem to have passed the Administration Building fork. First, go back along this paved path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 林の中を横切れば近そうですが、道がないので戻る方にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道のない近道を避けると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Cutting through the woods looks shorter, but there is no path, so I will go back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to avoid a shortcut without a path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。分かれ道に着いたら、出口の矢印を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. At the fork, you can check the arrow for the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻っても見つからなければ、そこで地図を見て聞き直します。今いる場所は何と呼びますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在地の名称を聞き聞き直す条件を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I still cannot find it after going back, I will look at the map there and ask again. What is this place called?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the current location's name and say when you will ask again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらは南側の広場です。地図のこの位置です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the southern square. Here it is on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 南側の広場から舗装路を戻り、管理棟の標識で出口を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻る経路と確認点を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will go back along the paved path from the southern square and check the exit at the Administration Building sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Restate the route back and the checking point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。分かれ道までの間は、ほかの細い道へ入らずお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Until you reach the fork, do not enter any other narrow paths.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発車案内が変わりました。お乗りになる列車は決まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The departure information has changed. Have you decided which train to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。十分前の表示を撮りました。この写真を会社へ送ろうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去の運行写真を送る予定を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I photographed the display ten minutes ago. I am thinking of sending this photo to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to send an earlier service-information photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その後に運転が再開しています。今の表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Services have resumed since then. Please also check the current display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真には見合わせ中とありますが、もう乗れるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再開済みか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The photo says services are suspended, but I can board now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that services have resumed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ただ、通常の時刻表どおりには運転していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. However, trains are not running according to the normal timetable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では「再開したが遅れは続いている」と伝えます。今来る列車は目的駅に止まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現状の伝え方と目的駅への停車を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will say “services have resumed, but delays continue.” Does the approaching train stop at my destination station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to describe the situation and whether the train stops at your station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その駅に停車します。乗る前に行先表示も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It stops there. Please also check the destination display before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真を送るなら、撮った時刻も添えて古い情報だと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影時刻を添えて過去情報と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If I send the photo, I will add the time it was taken and explain that it is old information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add the photo time and identify it as past information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の発車見込みは、この掲示でご案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The current expected departure is shown on this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい掲示を見て連絡し直します。到着予定は乗ってから再確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 更新後の情報で会社へ連絡し直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look at the new notice and contact them again. I will recheck the expected arrival after boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Contact your company again using updated information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。再開後も変更がありますので放送にお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Changes can still occur after services resume, so listen to the announcements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約について、どのような確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about your consultation appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約日に電話が来ると思っていましたが、この紙には部屋の場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えに場所があるのに電話相談だと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I would receive a phone call on the appointment day, but this paper gives a room location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought it was by phone despite a location on the confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 電話番号は、予約に関する連絡先として伺いました。当日の参加方法も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We asked your phone number as a contact for the booking. Let's also check how you are to attend that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話番号を書けば、電話相談になるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連絡用番号と参加方法の違いを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So writing my phone number does not automatically make it a telephone consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish a contact number from the attendance method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この控えでは来庁の相談として登録されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. This confirmation registers it as an in-person visit to the office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 移動が必要だとは考えていませんでした。その時刻に到着できるか調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来庁が必要なら移動時間を調べたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I had not thought I would need to travel. I want to check whether I can arrive at that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you need to check travel time if an office visit is required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが受付の場所です。相談開始前の受付についても案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the reception location. Please also read the instructions about checking in before the consultation starts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事の後に来ると遅れそうです。参加方法を変えられるか、担当へ相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅れそうなので参加方法の変更相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Coming after work, I may be late. Can I ask the person in charge whether the attendance method can be changed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about changing the attendance method because you may be late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更できるかは担当が確認します。来られない可能性を先にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check whether a change is possible. Please tell them first that you may not be able to come.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来庁予約をそのまま電話待ちにせず、移動できるかと変更の可否を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話待ちで欠席せず移動可否と変更を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not simply wait for a call while leaving an in-person appointment unchanged. I will check whether I can travel and whether a change is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check travel and changes instead of missing the visit by waiting for a call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今の予約番号を使って担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check with the person in charge using your current booking number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明細についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the itemized statement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この略語は私の病名ですか。説明された名前と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明細の略語が病名か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Is this abbreviation my diagnosis? It differs from the name explained to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the abbreviation on the statement is a diagnosis. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは算定した検査などの項目名です。病名を示すとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the name of a billed test or other item. It does not necessarily indicate a diagnosis.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。何を調べた検査だったか、もう一度聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査目的を改めて聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I would like to ask again what the test was checking for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask again about the test's purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付では検査の目的や結果を判断できません。診療科へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Reception cannot judge the purpose or result of a test. We will check with the clinical department.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今から先生に質問できますか。それとも次の診察で聞く方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 質問できる時点を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can I ask the doctor now, or would it be better to ask at the next consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask when you can put your question. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認しますので、少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait a moment while we check with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。「検査の目的と結果を知りたい」と伝えてください。料金の訂正を求めているのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金訂正と医療上の質問を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please say “I want to know the test's purpose and results.” I am not requesting a correction to the charges.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish a billing correction from a medical question. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から、次回の診察で説明するとのことです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge says they will explain it at your next consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次回の予約票に質問をメモします。明細も捨てずに持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回用に質問と明細を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the questions on my next appointment slip. I will keep the statement and bring it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the questions and statement for next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。明細の該当欄を示せるようにしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please make sure you can point out the relevant field on the statement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から借りた旅行かばんです。中には私の服が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りたかばんの紛失を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A travel bag I borrowed from a friend. My clothes are inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report losing a borrowed bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かばんの持ち主は友人、使っていたのはお客様ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bag belongs to your friend, and you were using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。黒い布製です。友人の名前の札が取っ手に付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札の名義が友人だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It is black fabric. A tag with my friend's name is attached to the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the name on the tag is your friend's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つかった時に、所有者にも確認が必要になる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If it is found, we may need to confirm with the owner too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人にはなくしたことを伝えました。連絡先を本人の了解を得て書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 了承を得た所有者連絡先の記載を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have told my friend I lost it. May I write their contact details with their permission?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about recording the owner's contact with their consent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのことも伺います。中にある物の特徴は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask about that too. Do you know the features of the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い作業着と白い靴です。かばんの札は友人名ですが、中身は私の物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中身の所有者と特徴を分けて答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Blue work clothes and white shoes. The bag's tag has my friend's name, but the contents belong to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the contents' owner and features separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に持っていた場所と時間をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give the last place and time you had it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日八時、駅前のベンチです。友人と私の連絡先を取り違えないよう欄を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最終場所と連絡先の区分を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yesterday at eight, on a bench in front of the station. I would like to check the fields so I do not mix up my contact details with my friend's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the last location and the distinction between contact fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 欄をご案内します。かばんと中身の関係も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will show you the fields. We will also record the relationship between the bag and its contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about a missed-delivery notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨でぬれて、このコードを読み取れません。再配達を申し込めないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 汚れたコードで申込みできないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It got wet in the rain, and I cannot scan this code. Does that mean I cannot request redelivery?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot apply because the code is damaged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号が読めるか確認しましょう。電話など別の方法もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check whether the number is readable. We can also explain other methods, such as by phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 下の数字は読めます。一か所だけ、三か八か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 読めない数字を断定せず示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can read the digits below. In just one place, I cannot tell whether it is three or eight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the unreadable digit without deciding what it is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 曖昧な数字を推測せず、配達記録と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will match it against the delivery records without guessing the unclear digit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。住所と名前はこちらです。間違った番号で別の荷物を申し込むのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人情報を出し誤番号の不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Here are my address and name. I am worried I might request a different parcel using the wrong number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Provide your details and explain your worry about a wrong number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 照合できました。番号を書き直した案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have matched it. We will give you instructions with the number rewritten clearly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は窓口で受け取らず、家で受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口受取ではなく再配達を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I want to receive it at home, rather than collect it at the counter today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request redelivery instead of counter collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では再配達の受付方法と、選べる日時をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please check how to request redelivery and the available dates and times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読める番号で電話します。申し込んだ日時を控えて、その時間は家にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済み番号で申し込み予定を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will phone using the readable number. I will note the time I book and stay at home then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply using the confirmed number and note the booked time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。不在票は受取が終わるまで保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Keep the missed-delivery notice until collection is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードが戻らないというご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a card that has not come back out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。そこのATMに入れた後、画面が止まりました。カードは機械の中だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カードが機械内に残った経過を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. After I inserted it into that ATM, the screen froze. I think the card is inside the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain how the card stayed in the machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの機械ですか。最後に出た案内を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which machine? Do you remember its last message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三番です。「係員をお呼びください」と出て、それ以上触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 機械番号と最後の画面を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Number three. It said “Please call a staff member,” and I have not touched it since.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the machine number and last screen message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。機械を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait without changing anything. We will check the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 引き出しを選びましたが、お金もまだ受け取っていません。取引が成立したか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金未受取と取引成立の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I selected withdrawal, but I have not received any cash either. Please check whether the transaction went through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not received cash and ask to check the transaction's completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードの取出しと取引記録を別々に調べます。暗証番号は口頭で言わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check card retrieval and the transaction record separately. Do not say your PIN aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。機械から取り出せるなら、紛失したカードとして再発行を頼む前に状況を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紛失再発行と機械回収を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If the card can be retrieved from the machine, I would like to hear the situation before asking for a replacement as a lost card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish lost-card replacement from machine retrieval. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご本人確認のうえ、この機械の記録で調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After verifying your identity, we will check this machine's records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人確認の書類を出します。カードと取引、両方の結果を聞いてから次を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認をして二つの結果を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will provide identification. I will hear the results for both the card and transaction before deciding what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Verify your identity and await both results. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認が済むまでこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait here until the checks are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 卵についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰宅して開けたら一個割れていました。漏れているので、写真とレシートだけ持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 漏れる商品を持参せず写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened them at home, one was broken. It is leaking, so I brought only photographs and the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show photos without bringing the leaking product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真を拝見します。いつお気付きになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the photos. When did you notice it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日、帰って冷蔵庫へ入れる時です。店で割れていたかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 破損に気付いた時点と不明点を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Today, when I got home and was putting them in the refrigerator. I do not know whether it was broken at the store.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say when you noticed the damage and what remains unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認のため商品の表示や状態も担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: For checking, we will also tell the person in charge the product labeling and condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 容器の表示も撮りました。実物を持参するなら、どう包めばよいか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実物持参の要否と包み方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I photographed the container's labeling too. If I need to bring the actual product, I want to ask how to wrap it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the actual item is needed and how to wrap it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が必要な確認方法をご案内しますので、無理に運ばずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain the necessary checks. Please wait without forcing yourself to carry it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。割れた卵は食べずに分けています。交換を決めつけず、まず状態を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未使用で分けてあり状態確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I have set the broken egg aside without eating it. I am not assuming an exchange; I would like the condition checked first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is set aside unused and request a condition check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が今こちらへ来ます。写真と購入時刻を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge is coming here now. Please let us check the photos and purchase time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午後二時に買いました。実物の扱いと今後の対応を担当から聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入時刻を答えて担当の案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I bought them at two in the afternoon. I will ask the person in charge how to handle the actual product and what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the purchase time and wait for guidance from the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認資料をそろえておつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will bring the checking materials together and put you in touch.
